title: PRAY THIS VIOLENT MORNING PRAYER BEFORE 7AM
text: All the lion of the tribe of Judah, the ancient of days, the one who was and who is and who is to come. We worship you this morning. We worship you, Father. Not because of what you have done, though. You have done great things, but because of who you are. You are Yahweh. You are El Shadai. You are the God who never fails. And right now in this atmosphere, we give you the highest praise. We give you the glory that belongs to your name. Receive our worship, oh God. receive the cry of our hearts. We are not here by accident. We are not here by coincidence. Something drew us into this place. Something stirred our spirits to wake before the sun and we know it is you, Father. It is your spirit calling onto our spirits and we respond. We are here. Speak, Lord. Move, Lord. Have your way. Hallelujah. Hallelujah. Hallelujah. Before I go any further, I want you to do something. Wherever you are watching this, whether you are in your room, in your car, at your place of work, whether it is still dark outside, I want you to share this prayer with someone. Send this to three people. Send it to five people. Send it to that brother, that sister, that friend, that colleague who is going through a difficult season. You do not know what God is about to do through this morning. You might be the instrument God uses to change a life today. Do not keep this to yourself. The anointing multiplies when it is shared. So pause for a moment right now and share this. Let someone else enter into this atmosphere with you. The Bible says in Ecclesiastes 4:es 9-10, "Two are better than one because they have a good reward for their labor. For if they fall, the one will lift up his fellow." Bring someone into this place. [music] Now listen carefully. There is a mystery about the morning that many believers have not yet understood. And I say this with all seriousness. The reason many people lose their day is because they never took authority over it before it began. You went into the day unarmed. You went into the day without a decree. You went into the day without establishing spiritual jurisdiction. And the enemy who is a legalist saw the gap and walked in. The Bible says in Psalm 53, "My voice shalt thou hear in the morning, O Lord. In the morning will I direct my prayer unto thee and will look up." David understood something. He understood that the morning is not just a time of day. It is a spiritual gateway. It is a threshold. It is the opening of a new dimension of time that God has assigned to you. And if you do not take authority over it, someone else or something else will Let me show you something. In Genesis chapter 1, every act of creation began with a word. God said, "Let there be light." And there was light. God said, "Let the waters be gathered." And it was so. Creation responds to words. Your day responds to words. Your morning responds to what is spoken over it before it unfolds. [music] This is why the enemy fights your prayer life in the morning more than at any other time. He does not want you to speak. He does not want you to decree because he knows the moment you open your mouth in the authority of the name of Jesus, things begin to shift. Look at what Mark 1:es 35 says. And in the morning rising up a great while before day, he went out and departed into a solitary place and there prayed. If Jesus the son of God, the word made flesh, the one through whom all things were created, if he found it necessary to rise early and pray, how much more you and I, how much more do we need to take the morning seriously? I am not talking about religion. I am not talking about routine. I am talking about violent intentional targeted prayer that shakes the foundations of every demonic agenda over your day. This is not a gentle devotion. This is warfare. Matthew 11 12 says, "And from the days of John the Baptist until now, the kingdom of heaven suffered violence, and the violent take it by force." The violent take it by force. Not the wishful, not the hopeful, not the passive, the violent. Those who rise up and say, "I refuse to let this day pass without my portion. I refuse to let the enemy steal what God has assigned to my hands today. I am taking it by force." There are blessings that have your name on them. I need you to hear this. There are doors that were scheduled to open for you today. There are connections that were ordained for you this very morning. There are phone calls, emails, conversations, ideas, breakthroughs, all assigned to your account in the heavenly realm. But they will not fall on you automatically. You must command them. You must call them forth. You must decree and declare them into manifestation. This is the principle of Job 22 28. Thou shalt also decree a thing, and it shall be established unto thee, and the light shall shine upon thy ways. You shall decree a thing, not wish, not hope, decree. There is governmental authority in your mouth as a child of God. There is legislative power in your tongue when it is submitted to the Holy Ghost. [music] When you open your mouth this morning, you are not making noise. You are issuing heavenly legislation over the affairs of your day. Now, thus said the spirit of God, and I want you to receive this word. The Lord says, "I have not brought you this far to abandon you at the gate of your breakthrough." The Lord says, "What you have been waiting for is closer than you think, but you must rise and possess it. You must open your mouth and command it. For I am a God who responds to faith. I respond to boldness. I respond to the violent cry of my children who refuse to be denied. I decree and declare over your life this morning. Every blessing that has been delayed, every good thing that has been withheld, every open door that was shut in your face, I command the release now in the name of Jesus. The blessing assigned to you today will not pass you by. It will not be rerouted. It will not be given to another. It is yours and you will lay hold of it before this day is over. Let me teach you something else. There are dimensions to this in 2 Kings chapter 3. There was a famine. Three kings came together. The king of Israel, the king of Judah, and the king of Edom. And they had no water. Their armies were dying. Their animals were dying. Everything was drying up. And they called for Elisha. And when Elisha spoke, he said something powerful. He said in verses 16 to1 17, "Make this valley full of ditches. For thus say the Lord, ye shall not see wind, neither shall ye see rain, yet that valley shall be filled with water, that ye may drink both ye and your cattle and your beasts." God told them to prepare for what they could not yet see. Dig ditches in dry ground. Make room for what is coming. Position yourself for the blessing even before it arrives. That is what this morning prayer is about. You are digging ditches. You are positioning your spirit. You are creating room in the spirit realm for what God is about to pour into your life today. And I am telling you, the water is coming. The rain is coming. The supply is coming. But you must dig. You must pray. You must decree. And I hear the spirit say there is someone listening to me right now. And you have been dealing with a pattern. A pattern of almost. A pattern of nearly. A pattern where things come close and then slip away. Where opportunities show up and then disappear. Where promises are made and then broken. And the Lord says, "I am breaking the pattern today." The cycle of almost is over. What is yours will not escape you again. Shaba rakatia shondolia. The spirit of God is moving. I can feel it. There is a weight in this place. There is a thickness of glory that is settling on this word right now. Do not take this lightly. Something is shifting in your life as you listen. Now, let us pray. And I mean pray, not whisper, not mama. Open your mouth. Let your voice rise. The Bible says in Psalm 47:1, "Oh, clap your hands all ye people. Shout unto God with the voice of triumph, not the voice of defeat, not the voice of doubt, the voice of triumph. You are not begging God. You are enforcing what he has already declared. You are commanding what heaven has already released. Father, in the name of Jesus, I thank you for this morning. I thank you that we are alive. I thank you that we have breath. I thank you that we have strength. I thank you that our minds are sound. I thank you that our hearts are beating. We do not take this for granted. Every breath in our lungs is evidence of your mercy. And so Lord, we come before you with boldness, not because of our righteousness, but because of the blood. The blood of Jesus gives us access. [music] The blood of Jesus gives us authority. The blood of Jesus gives us a voice in the courts of heaven. And we exercise that authority. Now I speak to this day. I speak to every hour, every minute, every second of this day. I command alignment. I command divine order. I decree that everything that was designed by God for me today will locate me. No confusion, no delay, no detour. Every blessing assigned to my hands today, I command you to manifest. Every door that God has ordained to open today, I command you to swing wide. Every connection that was divinely arranged, I decree divine convergence. The right people will find me. The right opportunities will locate me. The right words will be spoken in my favor. I come against every agenda of hell over this day. Every demonic assignment, every witchcraft projection, every arrow that was shot in the night, every incantation spoken against my progress, every enchantment pronounced over my destiny, I decree it is nullified, it is canceled, it is destroyed by the fire of the Holy Ghost. No weapon formed against me shall prosper and every tongue that rises against me in judgment I condemn. This is my heritage as a servant of the Lord. Isaiah 54 17. I bind every spirit of delay. I bind every spirit of confusion. I bind every spirit of error. I bind every spirit of near success syndrome. You will not operate in my life today. You will not operate in my family today. You will not operate in my finances today. You will not operate in my health today. I command you lose your hold in the name of Jesus. The Bible says, "Whatever I bind on earth is bound in heaven." Whatever I lose on earth is loosed in heaven. Matthew 18. And I bind every demonic operation and I lose the blessings of God upon my life. Father, I pray for my finances this morning. Every financial gate that has been shut, I command it to open now. Every embgo over my income, break. Every limitation over my earning capacity, break. Every covenant that is working against my prosperity, I dismantle it by the blood of Jesus. I decree unexpected money is coming my way today. Contracts are being signed in my favor. Business ideas are being downloaded into my spirit. Doors of financial increase are swinging open. I will not borrow. I will lend. I will not be the tail. I will be the head. Deuteronomy chapter 28 12-13. I decree supernatural provision. I decree kingdom wealth. I decree financial dominion. The Lord shall open unto me his good treasure. The heaven shall give rain unto my land in its season. And the Lord shall bless all the work of my hand. I will not struggle. I will not suffer. I will flourish. I will abound. I will have more than enough. Now I pray for your body. I speak to every sickness. I speak to every disease. I speak to every pain. I speak to every infirmity that is locking in your body this morning. I command it, leave now. The Bible says in Exodus 15 26, I am the Lord that health thee. He's Jehovah Rafa, the God who heals. And by his stripes you were healed. 1 Peter 2 24. Not you will be healed. You were healed. It is past tense. It is finished. It is done. Every migraine go. Every back pain go. Every kidney problem go. Every blood disease go. Every fibroid dissolve. Every tumor dry up. Every infection die. Every inflammation subside. I decree total healing. I decree total restoration. I decree that your body comes into alignment with the word of God this morning. You shall not die but leave and declare the works of the Lord. Psalm 118 17. I pray for your family. Every household cost I break it now. Every generational pattern of failure, poverty, divorce, baroness, untimely death, I uproot it from the foundation. I dig up every evil seed that was planted into your family line by the enemy. I release the fire of God upon every ancestral altar that is speaking against your household. Catch fire, burn to ashes. Every evil priest ministering against your family, I decree you are silenced. Your voice is cut off. Your power is destroyed. The blood of Jesus speaks better things over my family than the blood of any covenant. I decree peace upon your home. joy upon your household. Love among your family members, no division, no strife, no bitterness, no unforgiveness. [music] I release the spirit of reconciliation where there has been separation. I release the spirit of healing where there has been hurt. Families are being restored right now. Marriages are being healed right now. Children are being delivered right now. Parents are being set free right now. Someone under the sound of my voice I hear the Lord say the marriage will happen this year. You have been waiting. You have been praying. You have been wondering. And the Lord says the season of waiting is over. I am sending your spouse. Not a counterfeit, not a distraction. The one I have chosen for you. Prepare your heart. It is closer than you think. David, I hear that name in the spirit. David, the Lord says that business idea that you have been sitting on, launch it. I am your backer. I am your investor. I am your source. Do not wait for man's approval. You have mine. Step out and I will cause it to flourish beyond your imagination. There is a woman. I see you. You have been crying in the night. You have been carrying a burden that nobody else knows about. And the Lord says, "Give it to me. Cast your burden upon the Lord and he shall sustain you." Psalm 55 22 it says I have seen every tear. I have heard every prayer and I am moving on your behalf. The answer is in motion. Do not give up. Do not lose hope. Your morning of joy is here. Shaba rondoia shyaka. Fire. Fire. Fire of the Holy Ghost. Let it fall upon every life connected to this prayer. Let it pour. Let it cleanse. Let it deliver. Let it set free. Let it heal. Let it restore fire. I pray for your destiny this morning. Every hand of man that is tampering with your destiny, I cut it off. Every eye of witchcraft that is monitoring your progress, I blind it. Every mouth that is causing your future, I silence it. You are untouchable by the blood of Jesus. You are surrounded by the wall of fire. Zechariah 2:5 says, "For I say the Lord will be unto her a wall of fire round about and will be the glory in the midst of her. I decree your destiny is preserved. Your calling is protected. Your purpose is secured. No man and no devil can abort the plan of God for your life. What God has started in you, he is faithful to complete it." Philippians 1 6. You are not a mistake. You are not a failure. You are not forgotten. You are chosen. You are called. You are anointed. You are destined for greatness. I release angels right now. Ministering spirits, waring angels, angels of provision, angels of protection, angels of direction. I decree that they are dispatched on your behalf this morning. The Bible says in Hebrews 1:14, "Are they not all ministering spirits sent forth to minister for them who shall be heirs of salvation?" You are an heir of salvation and the angels are assigned to you. I command them to go forth and clear the path before you. Remove every obstacle, dismantle every roadblock, prepare the way for your blessing today. I speak to time. Every wasted year, I command restoration. Every stolen season I decree it is returned. Joel chapter 2 25. And I will restore to you the years that the locust had eaten the cankerm and the caterpillar and the palmer worm. My great army which I sent among you. God is a restorer. He is a redeemer of time. What the enemy has stolen, God is giving back with interest. I [music] decree accelerated recovery. I decree compressed blessings. What should have taken you 10 years to achieve, God will do it in one. What should have taken 5 years, he will do in a month. Supernatural acceleration is your portion. I come against every spirit of stagnation, every spirit that has kept you in one place, every invisible chain, every spiritual cage. I decree the cage is broken. The chain is shattered. You are free. You are moving forward. You are advancing. Nothing holds you back any longer. I speak to your mind this morning. I rebuke every spirit of fear, every spirit of anxiety, every spirit of depression, every spirit of suicidal thoughts, every spirit of hopelessness, every spirit of overwhelm. I command you, release this life. Now the Bible says in 2 Timothy 1:7, "For God hath not given us the spirit of fear, but of power and of love and of a sound mind." A sound mind is your covenant right. Peace of mind is your inheritance. I decree the peace of God that passes all understanding guards your heart and mind through Christ Jesus. Philippians 4 7. Now I want you to pray this with me. Lift your voice wherever you are. I decree that today is my day of supernatural breakthrough. I decree that today every blessing with my name on it will locate me without delay. I decree that favor surrounds me like a shield. Psalm 52. I decree that goodness and mercy follow me all the days of my life. I decree that the lines have fallen for me in pleasant places. Psalm 16 6. I decree that I walk in divine health. I walk in divine wealth. I walk in divine wisdom. I walk in divine favor. I walk in divine power. Every curse spoken against me in the last seven days, I break it. Every evil dream that was projected into my sleep, I cancel it. Every negative word that was whispered over my name, I reverse it. Every trap that was set for my feet, [music] I overturn it. The pit that was dug for me, the enemy falls into it himself. Psalm 7 15 I decree my children are blessed, my spouse is blessed, my parents are blessed, my siblings are blessed, my household is covered by the blood. No plague shall come near my dwelling. No evil shall befall me. Psalm 91 10. A thousand may fall at my side and 10,000 at my right hand, but they shall not come near me. Father, I thank you. I thank you because it is done. I thank you because you are faithful. I thank you because your word does not return void. Isaiah 55 11. Every word spoken in this prayer this morning, it is sealed. It is established. It is ratified in the courts of heaven. No demon can reverse it. No witch can undo it. No man can cancel it. It is the word of the living God and it stands forever. Grace. The Lord says your promotion is this month. Do not be anxious. It has already been decided in your favor. Walk in peace. Emmanuel, the Lord says, "Stop running from the call." He says, "I chose you before you were formed." Jeremiah 1:5. Stop running and yield. Your greatest fulfillment is in obedience. There is someone you have been dealing with a legal matter, a court case, a dispute, and the Lord says, "I am your advocate. I am fighting for you. The verdict will be in your favor. Trust me. Shondelobaya, Rakatia, Shababa, Endoria. The fire of God is burning. Can you feel it? The atmosphere is charged. The presence of God is thick. Something has shifted. Something has broken. Something has opened. You will never be the same after this morning. I decree the siege is over. The drought is over. The famine is over. The baroness is over. The shame is over. The reproach is over. You are stepping into a new season. A season of abundance. A season of overflow. A season where what God does for you will make your enemies ashamed. A season where your testimony will silence every critic. A season where your life becomes proof that God is real. Walk into this day with your head held high. You are not defeated. You are victorious. You are not abandoned. You are carried. You are not weak. You are strong in the Lord and in the power of his might. Ephesians chapter 6 10. Greater is he that is in you than he that is in the world. 1 John 4. This day belongs to you. Every blessing is yours. Every door is open. Every enemy is subdued. Every mountain is flattened. Every valley is lifted. The crooked places are made straight. Isaiah 40:4 and the glory of the Lord is revealed in your life. I seal this prayer with the blood of Jesus. I seal this day with the blood of Jesus. I seal your going out and your coming in with the blood of Jesus. I seal your home with the blood. I seal your vehicle with the blood. I seal your workplace with the blood. I seal your children with the blood. I seal your finances with the blood. Nothing crosses the bloodline. It is done. It is finished. It is established in Jesus mighty name. Amen. Amen and amen. Now go. Go with power. Go with fire. Go with authority. Go with the consciousness that the God of heaven is backing you today. Share this prayer with everyone you know. Let this fire spread. Let this anointing multiply. And as you step out, remember before 7:00 a.m. you have already won. The battle is over. The victory is yours. This is your day. This is your hour. This is your season. The Lord bless you and keep you. The Lord make his face to shine upon you and be gracious unto you. The Lord lift up his countenance upon you and give you peace. Numbers 6 24- 26. Go in power. Go in the name of Jesus. And may every single blessing assigned to your life today, not one of them will fall to the ground. In Jesus name we have prayed.
